title: Intro and Overview - PsyA01 Fall 2020
description: This video  provides an introduction and overview of the Fall 2020 offering of PsyA01: Introduction to Biological and Cognitive Psychology, a course offered at the University of Toronto Scarborough.  If you have any questions, feel free to post them here and I will try my best to answer quickly.

description: This video discusses the importance of "describing things mathematically" to thinking of something as having scientific merit.

description: This video focuses on the importance of Cartesian Dualism, both for suggesting psychology could be a science, and also for laying the foundation for animal research

description: A short video contrasting psychiatrists and psychologists

description: A discussion of the nature / nurture issue in the context of the late 1800s and early 1900s when the Eugenics movement was afoot

description: Discussing naturalistic observation in the context of Jane Goodall's work with Chimpanzees

description: From its first days, Psychology has included both subjective and objective measures.  This distinction is important to understand and consider so I discuss it briefly here.

description: Here I go over some of the highlights of correlations .. what they tell us, what they tempt us to believe, and why we should learn to be savy consumers of scientific information.

description: A discussion of experiments and the role they play in confirming causal relationships
